- TOTAL revenue reached £32.9k in TW versus £19.9k in LW, a WoW gain of 65.64%, and £9.5k in LY, a YoY gain of 245.56%.
- TOTAL units came to 11,786 in TW, up 102.51% WoW, while TOTAL orders reached 697, up 12.6% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked 1 in TW with £2,616.00 of revenue, an 8.0% share of TOTAL TW revenue.
- CHILLI LIGHTS posted £1,516.30 in TW for a 4.6% share, and HEART OF WICKER SMALL posted £1,365.96 for a 4.2% share.
- The top three products combined held 16.72% of TOTAL revenue in TW, with JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT at £1,356.16 and PARTY BUNTING at £1,301.83 following close behind.
- Largest WoW revenue gains came from CHILLI LIGHTS at £1,306.21 and HEART OF WICKER SMALL at £1,024.48.
- Largest WoW revenue declines came from VINTAGE UNION JACK BUNTING at £1,483.24 lower and REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER at £1,480.80 lower.
- On a percentage basis, CHARLOTTE BAG SUKI DESIGN rose 1,286.1% WoW and MINI PAINT SET VINTAGE rose 945.9% WoW.
